title: Human Resources Managers
description: Plan, direct, or coordinate human resources activities and staff of an organization.

tasks.text: Plan, direct, supervise, and coordinate work activities of subordinates and staff relating to employment, compensation, labor relations, and employee relations.
Perform difficult staffing duties, including dealing with understaffing, refereeing disputes, firing employees, and administering disciplinary procedures.
Administer compensation, benefits, and performance management systems, and safety and recreation programs.
Prepare and follow budgets for personnel operations.
Plan, organize, direct, control, or coordinate the personnel, training, or labor relations activities of an organization.
Oversee the evaluation, classification, and rating of occupations and job positions.
Analyze training needs to design employee development, language training, and health and safety programs.
Allocate human resources, ensuring appropriate matches between personnel.
Identify staff vacancies and recruit, interview, and select applicants.
Investigate and report on industrial accidents for insurance carriers.
Conduct exit interviews to identify reasons for employee termination.
Analyze and modify compensation and benefits policies to establish competitive programs and ensure compliance with legal requirements.
Analyze statistical data and reports to identify and determine causes of personnel problems and develop recommendations for improvement of organization's personnel policies and practices.

clusters.label: Coordinating the Work and Activities of Others

tasks.text: Represent organization at personnel-related hearings and investigations.
Develop or administer special projects in areas such as pay equity, savings bond programs, day care, and employee awards.

clusters.label: Resolving Conflicts and Negotiating with Others

tasks.text: Negotiate bargaining agreements and help interpret labor contracts.
Contract with vendors to provide employee services, such as food service, transportation, or relocation service.

clusters.label: Providing Consultation and Advice to Others

tasks.text: Advise managers on organizational policy matters, such as equal employment opportunity and sexual harassment, and recommend needed changes.
Provide terminated employees with outplacement or relocation assistance.

clusters.label: Communicating with Supervisors, Peers, or Subordinates

tasks.text: Serve as a link between management and employees by handling questions, interpreting and administering contracts and helping resolve work-related problems.
Plan and conduct new employee orientation to foster positive attitude toward organizational objectives.
Maintain records and compile statistical reports concerning personnel-related data such as hires, transfers, performance appraisals, and absenteeism rates.
Provide current and prospective employees with information about policies, job duties, working conditions, wages, opportunities for promotion, and employee benefits.
Prepare personnel forecast to project employment needs.
Study legislation, arbitration decisions, and collective bargaining contracts to assess industry trends.
Develop, administer, and evaluate applicant tests.

skills.name: Active Listening
skills.def: Giving full attention to what other people are saying, taking time to understand the points being made, asking questions as appropriate, and not interrupting at inappropriate times.

skills.name: Reading Comprehension
skills.def: Understanding written sentences and paragraphs in work-related documents.

skills.name: Speaking
skills.def: Talking to others to convey information effectively.

skills.name: Management of Personnel Resources
skills.def: Motivating, developing, and directing people as they work, identifying the best people for the job.

skills.name: Writing
skills.def: Communicating effectively in writing as appropriate for the needs of the audience.

skills.name: Coordination
skills.def: Adjusting actions in relation to others' actions.

skills.name: Critical Thinking
skills.def: Using logic and reasoning to identify the strengths and weaknesses of alternative solutions, conclusions, or approaches to problems.

skills.name: Active Learning
skills.def: Understanding the implications of new information for both current and future problem-solving and decision-making.

skills.name: Monitoring
skills.def: Monitoring/Assessing performance of yourself, other individuals, or organizations to make improvements or take corrective action.

skills.name: Social Perceptiveness
skills.def: Being aware of others' reactions and understanding why they react as they do.

skills.name: Complex Problem Solving
skills.def: Identifying complex problems and reviewing related information to develop and evaluate options and implement solutions.

skills.name: Judgment and Decision Making
skills.def: Considering the relative costs and benefits of potential actions to choose the most appropriate one.

skills.name: Time Management
skills.def: Managing one's own time and the time of others.

skills.name: Negotiation
skills.def: Bringing others together and trying to reconcile differences.

skills.name: Instructing
skills.def: Teaching others how to do something.

skills.name: Systems Evaluation
skills.def: Identifying measures or indicators of system performance and the actions needed to improve or correct performance, relative to the goals of the system.

skills.name: Learning Strategies
skills.def: Selecting and using training/instructional methods and procedures appropriate for the situation when learning or teaching new things.

skills.name: Persuasion
skills.def: Persuading others to change their minds or behavior.

skills.name: Service Orientation
skills.def: Actively looking for ways to help people.

skills.name: Systems Analysis
skills.def: Determining how a system should work and how changes in conditions, operations, and the environment will affect outcomes.

skills.name: Human resources software
skills.def: Software to manage employee evaluations, track wages or absenteeism, maintain safety records, or manage hours or time off. Examples: ADP Enterprise HR, ADP HR/Benefits Solution, ADP HR/Profile, ADP Workforce Now.

skills.name: Enterprise resource planning ERP software
skills.def: Software to integrate, monitor, or analyze data from multiple business operations within a unified system. Examples: Deltek Vision, Infor ERP SyteLine, Kronos Enterprise Workforce Management, Microsoft Dynamics.

skills.name: Office suite software
skills.def: Software to provide word processing, spreadsheet, e-mail, presentations, or data management capabilities. Examples: Corel WordPerfect Office Suite, Microsoft Office software.

skills.name: Spreadsheet software
skills.def: Software to create or edit numbers or text organized into rows and columns of cells. May include formulas which recalculate values based on other cells. Examples: IBM Lotus 1-2-3, Microsoft Excel.

skills.name: Electronic mail software
skills.def: Software to compose, send, or receive email. Examples: IBM Notes, Microsoft Outlook.

skills.name: Presentation software
skills.def: Software to create presentations, speeches, or slideshows. Examples: Mentimeter, Microsoft PowerPoint.
